lines: Chand yaadon ke siwa haath na kuchh aayega
couplets.en: Only a few memories will be yours to keep.

lines: Is tarah umr-e-gurezaan ka na peechha keeje
couplets.en: Do not chase the fleeting years so.

lines: Roshni auron ke aangan mein gawaara na sahi
couplets.en: Perhaps you cannot abide the light in another's courtyard.

lines: Kam se kam apne hi ghar mein to ujaala keeje
couplets.en: At least kindle a light in your own home.

lines: Kya khabar kab woh chale aayenge milne ke liye
couplets.en: Who knows when the one you long for might come to see you?

lines: Roz palkon pe nayi shammein jalaaya keeje
couplets.en: Light fresh candles on your lashes each day.
